command_behavior: static emits read-only requirement and implementation reports without invoking source rewriting
trace reads stored relations and classifies current, stale, or historical without writing source
package-identity reports the pinned source revision, toolchain, and enabled digest feature

artifact.reason: No realized pinned Buoy binary or Nix derivation is present in the comparison environment. The pinned consumer package sets doCheck = false, so building it would not execute comparison cases; full upstream Devenv acceptance requires private Atoll access, and the first source Cargo build downloads public registry dependencies. Upstream static, trace, and package-identity commands therefore did not run. Realizing the declared revision and source content hash would be required before any upstream observation can be executed.

mapping.semantic_subset: current, stale_requirement, stale_item, missing_object, ambiguous, unsupported, invalid_output

decision.reason: Cairn retains the independently specified fixtures and executed native mutation checks. Upstream observations stay declared and report-only until the pinned source closure is realized offline; the experiment does not justify permanent runtime adoption.

buoy_observation.reason: Declared from the pinned binding protocol: a fresh relation resolves as current. Not an upstream execution result.

buoy_observation.reason: Declared from the pinned binding protocol: CAB-RECORD-ABSENT or CAB-SUBJECT-STALE keeps the old relation out of current state. Not an upstream execution result.

cases.reason: Planted schema drift is refused by the native closed-schema reader before any accepting result. The selected upstream projection does not implement this input dimension, so no upstream result is inferred.

buoy_observation.reason: The selected upstream projection normalizes semantic text and CRLF and does not retain Cairn's exact byte spans, so the exact-span comparison dimension is not supported by the declared subset.

buoy_observation.reason: The exact-marker v1 Cairn profile records declaration linkage only and does not interpret Rust cfg. The in-progress rust_item_v1 profile owns structural cfg handling, so this comparison dimension is unsupported here.

cases.reason: Cairn's exact-marker project links the declaration without a cfg claim; a structural cfg interpretation belongs to the separately versioned Rust-item profile. The case stays named rather than silently waived.

buoy_observation.reason: The selected exact-marker Cairn projection has no historical binding record, and the pinned upstream artifact is unavailable. No historical row is promoted to a current relationship.

cases.reason: Historical-only accounting is outside the executed native subset; it remains an explicit unsupported case rather than a passing comparison.

buoy_observation.reason: The selected projection does not implement ambiguous mapping refusal. Native copied-marker drift is qualified separately by the duplicate_marker fixture.

cases.reason: Ambiguous mapping refusal has no executed upstream result; it is not inferred from the duplicate_marker case.

buoy_observation.reason: No upstream execution exists. Invalid, truncated, timed-out, or unavailable upstream output is nonaccepting infrastructure disposition and never a successful comparison.

cases.reason: The unavailable-tool dimension is declared blocked; it cannot become a pass without executed upstream evidence.
